messages:
marta: Heads-up — onboarding SparrowX-3B into the eval harness. Ran the icelandic suite and seeing token boundary noise that's blowing up n-gram metrics and the dashboard ingestion pipeline.

samir: can you paste an example of the tokenization diffs?

marta: sure. here's a minimal example — note how compound words split differently vs our tokenizer spec:

```
input: "Veturinn var mjög langur og kaldradur."
expected tokens (ours): [Veturinn,  , var,  , mjög,  , langur,  , og,  , kaldur, .]
SparrowX-3B tokens: [Vetur, inn,  , var,  , mjög,  , lang, ur,  , og,  , kaldur, .]
```

marta: that extra mid-word split causes BLEU/ROUGE-like ratios to tank and our eval-runner to treat many matches as mismatches.

rachel: is this a tokenizer config mismatch (vocab/normalization)? or an encoder change?

marta: looks like normalization + ZWJ/zero-width handling. SparrowX's tokenizer treats hyphenation and compounding differently. Also weird: it lowercases some Icelandic diacritics in pretoken step.

inge: quick thought — for CI we can patch a pretoken mapping for the icelandic suite (normalization shim) so metrics are comparable while we decide longer-term fix. Happy to make a tiny transform hook in eval-harness.

samir: +1 for a temporary shim. but we need to track this as a model-specific mapping in model-config so rollouts don't silently diverge. Add a flag like `token_normalizer: sparrowx3b: icelandic_shim_v1`.

marta: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/1287 — implements the shim and a toggle in model.yaml. CI job linked in PR fails currently due to dashboard schema error from the new metric buckets.

ci-bot: build 1287.2 failed — reporter: error writing metric 'token_split_rate' to /metrics/ingest: unexpected field 'tokenization_variant'

rachel: that schema change is from the new per-model metric tags we added last week. Looks like dashboard ingestion hasn't been updated to accept `tokenization_variant`.

marta: ok, I can make the reporter drop unknown tags for now. But we should update the dashboard schema to allow per-model tags (helps debugging).

inge: small patch idea: have reporter emit `token_split_rate` as usual and add a debug-only event `tokenization_variant` to the logs instead of metrics. Then ingestion won't break.

samir: fine short-term. long-term: add `tags` to metrics schema + backfill UI filters. I'll file a tracking ticket.

marta: filed TICKET-834: dashboard schema + UI filter for tokenizer variants.

eval-bot: eval-runner: icelandic_suite on sparrowx3b — 12 tests failed (baseline-adjusted) — see PR 1287 for logs.

rachel: after we merge the shim + reporter change, can someone run a full pass with quantized sparrowx3b q4f? I want to rule out quantization amplifying tokenization noise on downstream quality metrics.

marta: adding `quant-q4f` to the PR job matrix. running now.

ci-bot: job sparrowx3b-quant-q4f started — approx ETA 35m.

samir: FYI — let's not mask the tokenizer issue from production logs. Add a debug tag only for test runs; prod inference should surface raw tokenization for audits.

marta: agreed. I'll scope the shim to eval-harness only and make it opt-in via model config.

rachel: thanks. once we have green CI we'll update the onboarding checklist doc (docs/onboarding/models.md) with a tokenizer-sanity step: compare token counts & normalized diffs for 10 lang edgecases.

marta: noted — will add checklist entry and link PR.

samir: great work catching this early. small action items: 1) merge shim w/ reporter fallback, 2) run quant job, 3) open dashboard schema PR, 4) add checklist entry. Assign folks?

marta: I'll own 1+2. samir can take 3. rachel will add the checklist.

inge: ping me if you want help writing the normalization shim rules (I have some locale rules).

marta: thanks @inge :pray: — will DM the rules.

rachel: can we also add a small unit test in harness that asserts token_count_delta <= 2 for canonical lang pairs? prevent regressions.

marta: will add unit test.

ci-bot: job sparrowx3b-quant-q4f finished: success. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/eval/1287/artifacts

marta: CI green with quant. moving PR to review.

samir: merging once CI artifacts uploaded to dashboard (we want the before/after plots).

marta: uploaded artifacts and a short note in PR describing the shim's mapping table.

rachel: thanks team. follow-ups tracked in TICKET-834 and PR 1287. :white_check_mark:
